role: Tests for the log export's read of the log file (DebugLogger.readLogFile) and its fallback header (DebugLogger.unreadableFileSource): a missing file is empty, a readable one is its text, a non-UTF-8 file throws, and the fallback source line names the failure.
types: DebugLogExportTests: class — XCTestCase over a temporary directory; nested ReadFailure (a LocalizedError)
state: directory: <tmp>/DebugLogExportTests-<uuid> (created in setUpWithError, removed in tearDownWithError)

units.does: Asserts readLogFile of a path with no file returns ''.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Writes two lines to a file and asserts readLogFile returns them.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Writes bytes that are not UTF-8 (0xFF 0xFE) and asserts readLogFile throws.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts unreadableFileSource of a planted error says the log file could not be read and includes the error's description.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method discovered by its `test` prefix on the XCTestCase subclass

units.does: 'planted read failure': the description the fallback source line must carry.
